pr_title: sql: add a SHOW TENANTS command
pr_body:
This command prints all available tenants and their status.
To get the status for replication (c2c) tenants we need to get the job info.

For example:
```
    root@127.0.0.1:26257/defaultdb> show tenants;
      id |   name   |                               status
    -----+----------+----------------------------------------------------------------------
       1 | system   | ACTIVE
       2 | src      | ACTIVE
       3 | dest     | REPLICATION PAUSED
       4 | dest2    | REPLICATION UNKNOWN (succeeded)
       6 | dest3    | REPLICATION UNKNOWN (job with ID 819888096954253313 does not exist)
      11 | dest4    | ACTIVE
      12 | dest5    | REPLICATING
      13 | dest6    | INITIALIZING REPLICATION
    (13 rows)

    Time: 67ms total (execution 67ms / network 0ms)
```

Fixes: #92641

Epic: CRDB-18749

Release note: None

issue_context.title: sql: implement `SHOW TENANTS`
issue_context.body:
We already have `SHOW TENANT <name>`, it is useful to also have a flavor that shows all tenants instead of a specific one.

Epic: CRDB-18749

Jira issue: CRDB-21893

review_comments: It makes me a little nervous that we aren't failing loudly enough here. Should we log `ERROR: %s` instead of `REPLICATION UNKNOWN`, here and below?
Agree. If we have a non-zero jobID, that job ID should have a status we should be able to look up. This presents a non-trivial error I think.
added a log (to be clear we don't want to return an error, just log it).
